# Open Frame

> Open Frame is a design and marketing studio founded by Graham Ivy. It makes design and marketing easy and attainable for mission-driven organizations and brands, so they stand out while staying true to who they are. Based in Minneapolis, Minnesota and Barcelona, Spain, working on US hours with clients anywhere.

Open Frame is a studio of one: clients work directly with Graham Ivy from the first call to launch. Clients include nonprofits, cultural centers, community groups, startups and growing brands. Open Frame is not related to the openFrame open-source microscope project.

Contact: hello@openframe.design. Book a free 30-minute consult: https://calendly.com/grahamivy-co/30min

## Services

- [Services overview](https://openframe.design/services): what Open Frame offers and how a project runs
- Brand identity and strategy: logos, visual systems, brand guidelines, positioning and messaging
- Web and product design: websites, landing pages, product UX and UI, responsive build and handoff
- Marketing and content: campaigns, social media, content and copywriting, email and collateral
- Brand growth and consulting: brand audits, positioning, roadmaps and ongoing consulting

## Case studies

- [Wellness in the Woods](https://openframe.design/wellness-in-the-woods): brand overhaul and one design system for a free, 24/7 mental-health nonprofit; $1M in grants and 844% more fundraiser views
- [Needlework Guild of Minnesota](https://openframe.design/needlework-guild-of-mn): new identity, a token-based design system and 43 rebuilt pages for a guild founded in 1972, built so volunteers can keep it up
- [Hmong Cultural Center](https://openframe.design/hmong-cultural-center): responsive website redesign for a Saint Paul cultural center so people find classes and resources faster
- [HelloSpoke](https://openframe.design/hellospoke): rebrand and product-marketing website for a B2B unified-communications platform
- [Park n Go](https://openframe.design/park-n-go): UX research, UI design and brand system for an event parking app
